title: Exact restriction and normalized ordinary scalar-extension adjunction on a general ringed site
statement: For a site C with the sheafification hypotheses of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a morphism phi:O -> O' of commutative ring sheaves, and the module categories of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] preserves finite limits and finite colimits. For every additive functor E presenting the sheafified scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] on objects and maps, there exists an adjunction a:E ⊣ Res_phi such that its Hom correspondence sends f to the section map x |-> f(eta(1 tensor x)), where eta is the sheafification unit. Site, ring and module universes are independent exactly as in the parent theorem.

proof.text: Reuse the private SameSiteAdjunction construction of Sheaf.Paper.DerivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction, which already works at independent site universes: compose the sectionwise extension/restriction Hom equivalence with the module sheafification adjunction. Pure-tensor naturality gives naturality in both variables. The prescribed map equation identifies E naturally with this tensor functor, so transport the adjunction along that isomorphism. The transported Hom map on eqToHom(h M) followed by f reduces to the sectionwise evaluation formula by cancellation of equality transports.

Restriction followed by toSheaf is definitionally toSheaf for the source ring. The forgetful toSheaf functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits and reflects them; the latter colimit instance is the proved source-library sheafification result. Hence restriction preserves both by preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves and its colimit analogue.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D7 and 03DA; parent lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction, Steps 1–2; reuse of the existing private SameSiteAdjunction proof in Sheaf.Paper.DerivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction and the source-library toSheaf colimit API

theorem sheafRingCoefficientOrdinaryAdjunction (φ : O ⟶ O') :
    ∃ (_ : PreservesFiniteLimits (restrictScalars.{r}
                    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ)))
      (_ : PreservesFiniteColimits (restrictScalars.{r}
                    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ))),
    ∀ (E : SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O'))
      (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRings φ M),
      (∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f =
        eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom φ M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) →
      ∀ [E.Additive], ∃ a : E ⊣ restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ),
        (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O))
          (N : SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O'))
          (f : changeOfRings φ M ⟶ N) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U),
          (a.homEquiv M N (eqToHom (h M) ≫ f)).val.app U x =
            f.val.app U
              ((CategoryTheory.toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheaf φ M).presheaf).app U
                ((1 : O'.obj.obj U) ⊗ₜ[O.obj.obj U, (φ.hom.app U).hom] x)))
